premise: Nico sits on his board waiting for the perfect wave: too small, too bumpy; the boats go by while he waits, and at last the just-right wave carries him all the way in.
inspiration: The Goldilocks three-tries pattern at sea: not this one, not that one, and the patience to wait for the one that is just right.
lesson: The right moment is worth waiting for.

en-US.title: The Perfect Wave
en-US.text: {canvas:sunshine 0.6 40s} {surfer:enter} {surfer:go to sand} Nico wanted to catch the perfect wave. {surfer:face happy} {surfer:go to sea by paddle} He paddled out and sat on his board, waiting. Up and down. Up and down. A little wave came. {surfer:live shake-head} {surfer:says} [playfully] "Too small." Another came. {surfer:live shake-head} {surfer:says} "Too bumpy." [short pause] {sailboat:enter} The sailboat glided past, {sailboat:live sails} its sails puffing round and full. {fishing-boat:enter} The fishing boat chugged by, {fishing-boat:live net} and hauled up its net. {surfer:face sad} {surfer:says} [sad] "Where's MY wave?" {dog:enter} {dog:go to sand} Dog barked from far away, {dog:hop} as if to say: be patient. So Nico waited. And watched. And waited. [long pause] {surfer:face surprised} Then, far out, a wave began to rise, smooth and blue and just right. {surfer:glow 0.5} [excited] Nico stood up. {surfer:go to sand by surf} {sfx:wave} WHOOSH! He rode it all the way in, smooth as silk. {surfer:face happy} {surfer:live wave} He waved his board at the boats. {surfer:says} [happily] "THAT was the perfect wave!" {dog:hop x2}

es-ES.title: La ola perfecta
es-ES.text: {canvas:sunshine 0.6 40s} {surfer:enter} {surfer:go to sand} Nico quería coger la ola perfecta. {surfer:face happy} {surfer:go to sea by paddle} Remó mar adentro y se sentó en su tabla, esperando. Arriba y abajo. Arriba y abajo. Llegó una ola pequeña. {surfer:live shake-head} {surfer:says} [playfully] «Demasiado pequeña.» Llegó otra. {surfer:live shake-head} {surfer:says} «Demasiado movida.» [short pause] {sailboat:enter} El velero pasó deslizándose, {sailboat:live sails} con las velas redondas y llenas. {fishing-boat:enter} La barca de pesca pasó haciendo chuc, chuc, {fishing-boat:live net} y subió su red. {surfer:face sad} {surfer:says} [sad] «¿Dónde está MI ola?» {dog:enter} {dog:go to sand} Perro ladró desde lejos, {dog:hop} como diciendo: ten paciencia. Así que Nico esperó. Y miró. Y esperó. [long pause] {surfer:face surprised} Entonces, a lo lejos, empezó a levantarse una ola, suave, azul y perfecta. {surfer:glow 0.5} [excited] Nico se puso de pie. {surfer:go to sand by surf} {sfx:wave} ¡FIUUU! La cabalgó hasta el final, suave como la seda. {surfer:face happy} {surfer:live wave} Saludó a los barcos con la tabla. {surfer:says} [happily] «¡ESA sí que era la ola perfecta!» {dog:hop x2}

ja-JP.title: さいこうの 波
ja-JP.text: {canvas:sunshine 0.6 40s}{surfer:enter}{surfer:go to sand}ニコは、さいこうの波に、のりたいとおもっていました。{surfer:face happy}{surfer:go to sea by paddle}海へこぎだして、ボードにすわって、まちます。ゆーらゆら。ゆーらゆら。小さな波がきました。{surfer:live shake-head}{surfer:says}[playfully]「ちっちゃすぎ」 また、きました。{surfer:live shake-head}{surfer:says}「でこぼこすぎ」 [short pause]{sailboat:enter}ヨットが、すいーっととおりすぎます。{sailboat:live sails}帆は、まあるく、ふっくら。{fishing-boat:enter}漁船が、ポンポンポンととおって、{fishing-boat:live net}あみを引きあげました。{surfer:face sad}{surfer:says}[sad]「ぼくの波は、どこなのー？」 {dog:enter}{dog:go to sand}とおくの砂浜で、イヌくんが「ワン！」 {dog:hop}まるで、「あせらない、あせらない」 といっているみたい。だからニコは、まちました。じっと見て、まちました。[pause]{surfer:face surprised}すると、ずっとむこうで、波がもりあがってきました。なめらかで、青くて、ちょうどいい波です。{surfer:glow 0.5}[excited]ニコは、すっくと立ちあがりました。{surfer:go to sand by surf}{sfx:wave}ざざざーっ！砂浜まで、すーっと、なめらかに。{surfer:face happy}{surfer:live wave}ニコは、ふねたちに、ボードをふりました。{surfer:says}[happily]「これこれ！これが、さいこうの波！」 {dog:hop x2}

de-DE.title: Die perfekte Welle
de-DE.text: {canvas:sunshine 0.6 40s} {surfer:enter} {surfer:go to sand} Nico wollte die perfekte Welle erwischen. {surfer:face happy} {surfer:go to sea by paddle} Er paddelte hinaus, setzte sich auf sein Brett und wartete. Auf und ab. Auf und ab. Eine kleine Welle kam. {surfer:live shake-head} {surfer:says} [playfully] „Zu klein.“ Noch eine kam. {surfer:live shake-head} {surfer:says} „Zu holprig.“ [short pause] {sailboat:enter} Das Segelboot glitt vorbei, {sailboat:live sails} die Segel rund und prall. {fishing-boat:enter} Das Fischerboot tuckerte vorüber {fishing-boat:live net} und zog sein Netz hoch. {surfer:face sad} {surfer:says} [sad] „Wo bleibt denn MEINE Welle?“ {dog:enter} {dog:go to sand} Der Hund bellte von weit weg am Strand, {dog:hop} als wollte er sagen: Nur Geduld! Also wartete Nico. Und schaute. Und wartete… [pause] {surfer:face surprised} Dann, weit draußen, hob sich eine Welle, glatt und blau und genau richtig. {surfer:glow 0.5} [excited] Nico stand auf. {surfer:go to sand by surf} {sfx:wave} WUSCH! Er surfte darauf bis ganz an den Strand, glatt wie Seide. {surfer:face happy} {surfer:live wave} Er schwenkte sein Brett zu den Booten hinüber. {surfer:says} [happily] „DAS war die perfekte Welle!“ {dog:hop x2}

fr-FR.title: La vague parfaite
fr-FR.text: {canvas:sunshine 0.6 40s} {surfer:enter} {surfer:go to sand} Nico voulait attraper la vague parfaite. {surfer:face happy} {surfer:go to sea by paddle} Il a ramé jusqu’au large, puis il s’est assis sur sa planche pour attendre. Ça montait, ça descendait. Ça montait, ça descendait. Une petite vague est arrivée. {surfer:live shake-head} {surfer:says} [playfully] « Trop petite. » Une autre est venue. {surfer:live shake-head} {surfer:says} « Trop de bosses. » [short pause] {sailboat:enter} Le voilier est passé en glissant, {sailboat:live sails} les voiles bien rondes, bien gonflées. {fishing-boat:enter} Le bateau de pêche est passé en faisant teuf-teuf, {fishing-boat:live net} et il a remonté son filet. {surfer:face sad} {surfer:says} [sad] « Et MA vague, elle est où ? » {dog:enter} {dog:go to sand} Chien a aboyé de loin, sur la plage, {dog:hop} comme pour dire : patience ! Alors Nico a attendu. Et regardé. Et attendu. [pause] {surfer:face surprised} Puis, tout au large, une vague a commencé à monter, lisse et bleue, juste comme il faut. {surfer:glow 0.5} [excited] Nico s’est mis debout. {surfer:go to sand by surf} {sfx:wave} FIOUUU ! Il l’a surfée jusqu’au bout, tout en douceur, comme sur de la soie. {surfer:face happy} {surfer:live wave} Il a salué les bateaux avec sa planche. {surfer:says} [happily] « CELLE-LÀ, c’était la vague parfaite ! » {dog:hop x2}

it-IT.title: L'onda perfetta
it-IT.text: {canvas:sunshine 0.6 40s} {surfer:enter} {surfer:go to sand} Nico voleva prendere l'onda perfetta. {surfer:face happy} {surfer:go to sea by paddle} Ha remato fino al largo e si è seduto sulla tavola, ad aspettare. Su e giù. Su e giù. È arrivata un'ondina. {surfer:live shake-head} {surfer:says} [playfully] «Troppo piccola.» Ne è arrivata un'altra. {surfer:live shake-head} {surfer:says} «Troppo mossa.» [short pause] {sailboat:enter} La barca a vela è passata scivolando, {sailboat:live sails} con le vele gonfie e tonde. {fishing-boat:enter} Il peschereccio è passato, tuf tuf, {fishing-boat:live net} e ha tirato su la rete. {surfer:face sad} {surfer:says} [sad] «E la MIA onda, dov'è?» {dog:enter} {dog:go to sand} Cane ha abbaiato da lontano, {dog:hop} come per dire: pazienza. Così Nico ha aspettato. E ha guardato. E ha aspettato ancora. [pause] {surfer:face surprised} Poi, laggiù al largo, ha cominciato ad alzarsi un'onda, liscia, blu e proprio giusta. {surfer:glow 0.5} [excited] Nico si è alzato in piedi. {surfer:go to sand by surf} {sfx:wave} SCIUUU! L'ha cavalcata fino alla spiaggia, liscio come l'olio. {surfer:face happy} {surfer:live wave} Ha salutato le barche sventolando la tavola. {surfer:says} [happily] «QUELLA sì che era l'onda perfetta!» {dog:hop x2}

zh-TW.title: 最完美的浪
zh-TW.text: {canvas:sunshine 0.6 40s}{surfer:enter}{surfer:go to sand}尼可想衝一道最完美的浪。{surfer:face happy}{surfer:go to sea by paddle}他划呀划，划到海上，坐在衝浪板上等著。上上下下。上上下下。一道小浪來了。{surfer:live shake-head}{surfer:says}[playfully]「太小了。」 又一道來了。{surfer:live shake-head}{surfer:says}「歪七扭八的。」 [short pause]{sailboat:enter}帆船輕輕滑過去，{sailboat:live sails}帆鼓得圓圓的、飽飽的。{fishing-boat:enter}漁船噗噗噗地開過來，{fishing-boat:live net}拉起了網子。{surfer:face sad}{surfer:says}[sad]「我的浪呢？我的浪到底在哪裡？」 {dog:enter}{dog:go to sand}小狗在沙灘上遠遠地汪汪叫，{dog:hop}好像在說：要有耐心喔。於是尼可等呀等。看呀看。又等呀等。[pause]{surfer:face surprised}這時候，遠遠的地方，一道浪慢慢升起來，平平滑滑、藍藍的，剛剛好。{surfer:glow 0.5}[excited]尼可站起來了！{surfer:go to sand by surf}{sfx:wave}唰——！他乘著浪一路滑回來，順得不得了。{surfer:face happy}{surfer:live wave}他舉起衝浪板，向兩艘船揮一揮。{surfer:says}[happily]「這個，才是最完美的浪！」 {dog:hop x2}

zh-HK.title: 完美的浪
zh-HK.text: {canvas:sunshine 0.6 40s}{surfer:enter}{surfer:go to sand}尼可想等一個完美的浪。{surfer:face happy}{surfer:go to sea by paddle}他划了出去，坐在滑浪板上等。一上，一落。一上，一落。一個小浪來了。{surfer:live shake-head}{surfer:says}[playfully]「太細喇。」 又一個浪來了。{surfer:live shake-head}{surfer:says}「太顛喇。」 [short pause]{sailboat:enter}帆船輕輕滑過，{sailboat:live sails}帆鼓得圓圓的、飽飽的。{fishing-boat:enter}漁船噗噗噗地駛過，{fishing-boat:live net}拉起了網。{surfer:face sad}{surfer:says}[sad]「我嘅浪喺邊呀？」 {dog:enter}{dog:go to sand}小狗在遠遠的沙灘上汪汪叫，{dog:hop}好像在說：慢慢等，別心急。於是，尼可等呀等。看呀看。又等呀等。[pause]{surfer:face surprised}然後，在很遠很遠的地方，一個浪慢慢升起來，又平又藍，剛剛好。{surfer:glow 0.5}[excited]尼可站了起來。{surfer:go to sand by surf}{sfx:wave}唰——！他一直滑回沙灘，滑得像絲綢一樣順。{surfer:face happy}{surfer:live wave}他向兩隻船揮動滑浪板。{surfer:says}[happily]「呢個先係完美嘅浪呀！」 {dog:hop x2}
